rationale: The instrument spiked to $10.90 and has already pulled back ~45 cents to $10.45, placing price at only 40% of the day's range and below the 5-minute VWAP — the initial momentum burst has visibly exhausted without a confirmed re-entry structure. The 172 bps bid-ask spread creates an immediate and severe friction cost that eliminates most of any edge in either direction on this micro-cap float. With no identifiable news catalyst, no EMA or ATR data to define a clean invalidation level, and already-realized losses today reducing the loss budget, the risk/reward does not justify committing capital here.
